description.zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳
description.en: The start timestamp of the query range.

description.zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳
description.en: The end timestamp of the query range.

description.zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填。
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the messages belong. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 查询任务的 ID。首次查询不需要输入，后续取消息必须传入，根据前一次的返回结果取出该字段。
description.en: The ID of the query task. This parameter is not required for the first query. For subsequent queries, this parameter is required. Obtain the value from the response of the previous query.

description.zh: 需查询的消息的 Topic 名称
description.en: The topic name of the messages to query.
